  1. Density of polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms

Imports
import LindenstraussPolynomials.Core

Main results

  • Lemma lem:isometry: the canonical extension preserves the norm, for scalar- and vector-valued polynomials.

  • Theorem thm:main: for every continuous n-homogeneous scalar polynomial P (n\ge1) and every \varepsilon>0 there are Q and z in the unit ball of X^{**} with \|Q-P\|<\varepsilon and |\widetilde Q(z)|=\|\widetilde Q\|=\|Q\|; equivalently, such polynomials are dense.

  • Theorem thm:vector: the same for polynomials with values in a Banach space Y.

Here \|\widetilde Q\| is the supremum of \|\widetilde Q(z)\| over the closed unit ball of the bidual. X need not be complete; only Y is assumed complete in the vector-valued case.

Norm preservation (Lemma lem:isometry, Davie–Gamelin), vector-valued version: sup_{‖z‖ ≤ 1} ‖P̃(z)‖ = ‖P‖.

Theorem thm:vector (polynomial Lindenstrauss theorem, vector-valued). For every continuous n-homogeneous polynomial P : X → Y (n ≥ 1, Y complete) and every ε > 0 there are a continuous n-homogeneous polynomial Q with ‖Q - P‖ < ε and a point z of the closed unit ball of X** with ‖Q̃(z)‖ = ‖Q̃‖ = ‖Q‖.

Theorem thm:main (polynomial Lindenstrauss theorem, scalar-valued; 𝕜 = ℝ or ℂ). For every continuous n-homogeneous polynomial P : X → 𝕜 (n ≥ 1) and every ε > 0 there are a continuous n-homogeneous polynomial Q with ‖Q - P‖ < ε and a point z of the closed unit ball of X** with |Q̃(z)| = ‖Q̃‖ = ‖Q‖.

theorem polynomial_lindenstrauss {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {P : X → 𝕜} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ Q : X → 𝕜, IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Q ∧ polyNorm (Q - P) < ε ∧ ∃ z : Bidual 𝕜 X, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) ∧ polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) = polyNorm Q := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pε:ℝhε:0 < ε⊢ ∃ Q, IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Q ∧ polyNorm (Q - P) < ε ∧ ∃ z, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) ∧ polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) = polyNorm Q 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pε:ℝhε:0 < εQ:X → 𝕜hQ:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n QhQP:polyNorm (Q - P) < εz:Bidual 𝕜 Xhz:‖z‖ ≤ 1h1:‖abExtV 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExtV 𝕜 n Q)h2:polyNorm (abExtV 𝕜 n Q) = polyNorm Q⊢ ∃ Q, IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Q ∧ polyNorm (Q - P) < ε ∧ ∃ z, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) ∧ polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) = polyNorm Q 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pε:ℝhε:0 < εQ:X → 𝕜hQ:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n QhQP:polyNorm (Q - P) < εz:Bidual 𝕜 Xhz:‖z‖ ≤ 1h1:‖abExtV 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExtV 𝕜 n Q)h2:polyNorm (abExtV 𝕜 n Q) = polyNorm Q⊢ ‖abExt 𝕜 n Q z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n Q) All goals completed! 🐙

The density formulation of Theorem thm:main: every continuous n-homogeneous scalar polynomial is a limit, in the norm ‖·‖, of polynomials whose canonical extensions attain their norms.

theorem polynomial_lindenstrauss_dense {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {P : X → 𝕜} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) : ∃ Q : ℕ → X → 𝕜, (∀ k, IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k) ∧ ∃ z : Bidual 𝕜 X, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => polyNorm (Q k - P)) atTop (𝓝 0) := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ ∃ Q, (∀ (k : ℕ), IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k) ∧ ∃ z, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))) ∧ Tendsto (fun k ↦ polyNorm (Q k - P)) atTop (𝓝 0) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n PQ:ℕ → X → 𝕜hQ:∀ (k : ℕ), IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k)hQP:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (Q k - P) < 1 / (↑k + 1)z:ℕ → Bidual 𝕜 Xhz:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖z k‖ ≤ 1h1:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) (z k)‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))a✝:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k)) = polyNorm (Q k)⊢ ∃ Q, (∀ (k : ℕ), IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k) ∧ ∃ z, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) z‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))) ∧ Tendsto (fun k ↦ polyNorm (Q k - P)) atTop (𝓝 0) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n PQ:ℕ → X → 𝕜hQ:∀ (k : ℕ), IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k)hQP:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (Q k - P) < 1 / (↑k + 1)z:ℕ → Bidual 𝕜 Xhz:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖z k‖ ≤ 1h1:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) (z k)‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))a✝:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k)) = polyNorm (Q k)⊢ Tendsto (fun k ↦ polyNorm (Q k - P)) atTop (𝓝 0) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕhn:1 ≤ nP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n PQ:ℕ → X → 𝕜hQ:∀ (k : ℕ), IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (Q k)hQP:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (Q k - P) < 1 / (↑k + 1)z:ℕ → Bidual 𝕜 Xhz:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖z k‖ ≤ 1h1:∀ (k : ℕ), ‖abExt 𝕜 n (Q k) (z k)‖ = polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k))a✝:∀ (k : ℕ), polyNorm (abExt 𝕜 n (Q k)) = polyNorm (Q k)⊢ Tendsto (fun k ↦ 1 / (↑k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) All goals completed! 🐙
end LindenstraussPolynomials
